using Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestTools.UnitTesting;

// Saved as .txt rather than .cs. cyber-dojo.sh hands the compiler what find
// names for *.cs, so this one is never compiled and MSTest never sees the
// test. Calling it something other than HikerTest.cs would not have been
// enough on its own: MSTest gathers tests by the [TestClass] and [TestMethod]
// attributes and does not care which file they came from, so a .cs file under
// any name at all still runs. The extension is what keeps this one out.
//
// The assertion below is one that would fail, so a green says this really did
// not run rather than that it ran and passed.
[TestClass]
public class AnswerSizeTest
{
    [TestMethod]
    public void the_answer_is_three_digits_long()
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(3, new Hiker().Answer().ToString().Length);
    }
}
